notes: Adds the six verified MangoLite BLE Control v1 methods to the existing public searchable Student API contract. The three deferred OLED image APIs remain unpromoted.

entries.name: on_control
entries.zh: 註冊 BLE Control 正規化控制事件
entries.en: Register a normalized BLE Control event

entries.name: on_control_pressed
entries.zh: Dabble Digital Gamepad 指定按鍵按下時執行 callback
entries.en: Run a callback when a Dabble Digital Gamepad control is pressed

entries.name: on_control_released
entries.zh: Dabble Digital Gamepad 指定按鍵放開時執行 callback
entries.en: Run a callback when a Dabble Digital Gamepad control is released

entries.name: on_control_joystick
entries.zh: 接收 Dabble Analog Joystick 的 angle 與 radius
entries.en: Receive angle and radius from the Dabble Analog Joystick

entries.name: control_name
entries.zh: 取得目前有效的 BLE Control 裝置名稱
entries.en: Get the effective BLE Control device name

entries.name: control_connected
entries.zh: 檢查 primary BLE controller 是否已連線
entries.en: Check whether the primary BLE controller is connected
